Deliver [[Ambassador Zain]]'s strongbox to [[Gate Guard Hollis]] to secure some much-needed protection for him and his men.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| complete = [[The Ambassador's Quandary]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Find Gate Guard Hollis at the eastern gate in [[Old Ascalon]]]. Give him [[Zain's Strongbox|Zain's strongbox]].
* Return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 Experience
* 50 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Jeweled Chalice]]
** [[Energy]] +6 (Requires 5 [[Illusion Magic]])
** Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%)
** Armor +5 (while enchanted)

==Walkthrough==
Walk northwest from Ambassador Zain. Keep going west along [[Great Northern Wall|the Wall]] until you reach the portal leading out into [[The Breach]]. Gate Guard Hollis is standing in front of the sign. Speak with him and return to Zain for your reward.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Ambassador Zain
:''"You've been a friend to me, and I'm grateful. Now I have another favor to ask. My men and I are in constant danger as long as we remain here. I have physical evidence of the threat, something that might convince the Vanguard to help. If you'll take it to '''Gate Guard Hollis''', perhaps the Vanguard will agree to provide protection for us. You'll find him guarding the '''eastern gate''' in Old Ascalon."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = If you would deliver the evidence to '''Gate Guard Hollis''' at the eastern gate, I'd be most grateful.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Gate Guard Hollis
:''"Ahh, nothing like the jingle of gold, eh? This will do nicely. Nicely, indeed. Ambassador Zain will have his protection. Yes he will."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Ambassador Zain
:'' 'Ah, so you saw the "evidence" Guard Hollis required. Yes, well, we do what we must in this life. Thank you for delivering it.' ''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The rewarded Jeweled Chalice has what would normally be the skin and attribute of a [[Jeweled Chakram (metal)|Jeweled Chakram]]. Conversely, the quest [[Frontier Gate Fugitives]] rewards a Jeweled Chakram with the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chalice.}}
